plain_english_policy: This bill increases the fee for a pistol permit in Choctaw County from an unspecified previous amount to $20. The revenue collected by this new fee must be deposited into a fund managed at the sheriff's discretion.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would result in a higher cost for residents of Choctaw County seeking a pistol permit, with the additional funds directed toward county-level administrative or operational needs determined by the local sheriff.
sponsorship_supports_position: Senator Keahey (N & P) sponsored this bill.
evidence_quotes: "Relating to Choctaw County; to amend Section 45-12-232 of the Code of Alabama 1975, relating to pistol permit fees; to increase the pistol permit fee."
"In Choctaw County, the fee for issuance of a permit... shall be twenty dollars ($20)"
